args.message: Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was documented (and required by FIN-212) to use banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), but the implementation used `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This caused the nightly build to fail, since `tests/test_money.py` asserts half-even behavior:

- `Decimal("2.665")` rounded to `2.67` (half-up) instead of the required `2.66` (half-even).

## Changes
- Changed the rounding mode in `src/money.py` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` to match the docstring, the FIN-212 requirement, and the test expectations.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` (sha `08d3cd5986`): passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
